FN-JPZRGFN-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 324
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/15/2025
Senate Bill 324 as introduced would add two additional members to the Board of Pardons and
Paroles, which would increase the obligations of the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles by: (1) an
estimated $700 per meeting of the Board; and (2) a Bureau estimated $150,000 per appointee for
salaries and benefits.
In addition, this bill could decrease the obligations of the Department of Corrections by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of inmates initially denied parole but
reconsidered for parole pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-JPZRGFN-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 324
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/29/2025
Senate Bill 324 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Board of Pardons and
Paroles by: (1) an estimated $303,000 annually for salaries and benefits for the two members
added to the board pursuant to this bill; and (2) an estimated $700 per meeting of the board.
In addition, this bill could decrease the obligations of the Department of Corrections by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of inmates initially denied parole but
reconsidered for parole pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
